files.data/README.md:
# Data of the world geo.map

Since the schema + acts switch (2026-11-14) the world keeps NO knowledge base: the places come by lookup from the catalog's `k.geo` (`places.mjs`). The table below records where the catalog's own data came from (it was built from these packages by `scripts/build-geo-data.mjs` when the world held the data); the offline outlines and label places in `docs/webchat/vendor/map/` stay the map tab's renderer data.

| Data | Package (version) | Licence | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Countries: names, capitals, region, borders, area, currencies, languages, landlocked | world-countries 5.1.0 (mledoze/countries) | ODbL 1.0 (attribution and share-alike for the database) | `geo.map.country` wires |
| Country population | country-json 2.3.0 (country-by-population, about 2018 estimates) | MIT | `pop` of countries (Timor-Leste added by hand: World Bank 2018) |
| Cities | all-the-cities 3.1.0 (GeoNames gazetteer, https://www.geonames.org) | CC BY 4.0 (attribution required) | `geo.map.city` wires: 246 capitals, every city of 500,000+ people, Romanian and Moldovan cities of 30,000+ (1001 in all) |
| Country outlines (offline base map) | world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-50m (Natural Earth) | public domain | `docs/webchat/vendor/map/countries-50m.json`, bounding boxes of countries (`bb`) |
| Groups (EU, NATO, Nordic ...) | hand-written, as of 2024 | none | `geo.map.region` wires of kind `group` |

Every KB wire carries its source and licence in `core.source`. Population figures are rough and dated; city populations are GeoNames city-proper values (a few large cities are much smaller than their metro areas).

Counts: 250 countries and territories (194 independent), 1001 cities, 38 regions, 1464 lexicon names. Capitals without a GeoNames match (no city wire; the capital name is still known): EH:El Aaiún, IO:Diego Garcia, TK:Fakaofo.

Rebuild: `npm i world-countries@5.1.0 all-the-cities@3.1.0 country-json@2.3.0 world-atlas@2.0.2 topojson-client@3.1.0` in a temporary directory, then `node scripts/build-geo-data.mjs --modules <dir>/node_modules`.

@legend.geo.map core.legend
    namespace=geo.map
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Places of the world (countries, cities, regions) and the state of a map view. Facts are generated from open datasets by scripts/build-geo-data.mjs."

@geo.map.view core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The map view. The world state holds center, zoom, bounds, markers, highlighted countries, lines, layer, focus, me."
    example="Show me Bucharest."

@geo.map.place core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A named place with a position: a country, a city or a region."
    example="Paris is in France."

@geo.map.place.name core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is the place called?"

@geo.map.place.key core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which lexicon words name this place?"

@geo.map.place.cc core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) is it?"

@geo.map.place.pop core.key
    value=integer
    ask="How many people live there?"

@geo.map.place.lat core.key
    value=number
    ask="What is its latitude?"

@geo.map.place.lon core.key
    value=number
    ask="What is its longitude?"

@geo.map.place.bb core.key
    value=string
    ask="What is its bounding box (south,west,north,east)?"

@geo.map.country core.type
    extends=geo.map.place
    doc="A country or territory (ISO 3166-1)."
    example="Romania is a country."

@geo.map.country.capital core.key
    value=string
    card=many
    ask="What is its capital?"

@geo.map.country.cont core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Which continent is it in?"

@geo.map.country.sub core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which UN subregion is it in?"

@geo.map.country.area core.key
    value=integer
    ask="What is its area in square kilometres?"

@geo.map.country.nb core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which countries border it (country codes)?"

@geo.map.country.cur core.key
    value=string
    card=many
    ask="Which currency does it use?"

@geo.map.country.lang core.key
    value=string
    card=many
    ask="Which languages are spoken there?"

@geo.map.country.land core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Is it landlocked?"

@geo.map.country.ind core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Is it an independent country?"

@geo.map.city core.type
    extends=geo.map.place
    doc="A city: a capital, a city of 500,000+ people or a Romanian or Moldovan town of 30,000+."
    example="Cluj-Napoca is a city."

@geo.map.city.capital core.key
    value=boolean
    ask="Is it a capital?"

@geo.map.region core.type
    extends=geo.map.place
    doc="A continent, UN subregion or group of countries (EU, Nordic ...), or the world."
    example="Europe is a continent."

@geo.map.region.kind core.key
    value=atom
    ask="Is it a continent, subregion, group or the world?"

@geo.map.region.members core.key
    value=string
    ask="Which countries are in it (country codes)?"

files.schema.sop:
@map acts.schema
    noun="map"
    doc="The map as a schema (spec 21 section 12): places (any place of k.geo, found by lookup), pins, routes, labels and the view of the map; a place has a name, a colour (highlighted), a capital, a population ...; the view has a zoom and a centre. The renderer (Leaflet over the offline outlines, docs/webchat/ui/tabs/map.mjs), the projection and zoom fitting, the distances and the geolocation stay the world's own (map.mjs); the places come from the catalog (places.mjs). Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

files.world.sop:
@world.geo.map core.world
    namespace=geo.map
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.geo.map
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.kids.common
    imports=world.acts
    imports=world.lang.common
    formalization=rules
    undo=geo.undo
    redo=geo.redo
    source="what I know about places"
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="World map"
    summary="show places on a map"
    tab=map
    tabTitle="Map"
    tabAlias=world_map
    tabAlias=atlas
    tabOrder=60
    tabKind=tool
    doc="A voice-controlled map: every country, capital, city of 500,000+ people and Romanian and Moldovan towns of 30,000+, with population, area, borders, currency and languages. Moving, zooming, markers, highlighted countries, distance lines, comparisons and questions about places. State lives in ctx.state; the host draws it with Leaflet over an offline country outline map (street map tiles optional). The places come by lookup from the catalog (k.geo: Natural Earth, countries ODbL, GeoNames CC BY 4.0), see data/README.md. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."

# Typed needs (sopworld 0.39.0, std.schema.needs): the collections of k.geo the operations read synchronously (countries, cities, groups, the other names of countries), loaded before an operation of this world runs.
@need.geo.map.countries std.schema.needs
    of=geo.map
    type=k.geo.country
    from=k.geo
@need.geo.map.cities std.schema.needs
    of=geo.map
    type=k.geo.city
    from=k.geo
@need.geo.map.groups std.schema.needs
    of=geo.map
    type=k.geo.group
    from=k.geo
@need.geo.map.words std.schema.needs
    of=geo.map
    type=core.word
    from=k.geo
